method: Direct original Nogova R01WarCry developer harness, copied profiles, --nosound, sync validation. Grounded standing cameras. Auto/TAA100%, RT sun/cloud shadows, AO/water/volumetrics off, one bounce. Warm10, Off/On/On/Off settle4/sample6, probes off; no build/census/other game during timing. Not Steam-route or mission-completion acceptance.
visualLimits: Small original chimney detail, not broad facade relighting. Town-house/cottage native reception is demonstrated; school totals include existing masonry and hotel front/east views do not demonstrate new native chimney reception. Hotel forced-CPU masonry increases relative to paired baseline, but both baseline and candidate have an existing black roof in that route: not clean whole-scene CPU acceptance. Cropped/obstructed scouts are diagnostic only. Family totals are not source-specific percentages. Bounded grid/phase probes observe no new chimney identity; no claim of observed new-source reflected transport or zero all-world transport. MSAA retains existing spatial-only single-sample GI grain, not clean MSAA visual acceptance.
batchAcceptance: Exact brick-only whole-face regions use existing paths, subject to documented live capture limits. All13 models remain partial source reviews. Full726-model goal incomplete.
